purpose: Turn a request into a plan the builder can implement without asking questions.
summary: Plan adds a detect_test_argv() step to install.py that rewrites the test placeholder for pytest, bun, and npm projects, with one fixture test per branch.
commit_message: Add spec for detecting the test command at install time
notes_for_next_agent: Detection must only read pyproject.toml, package.json, and bun.lock at the target root. Keep quality.py's _placeholder() so the lint/typecheck/build blocks are unchanged; only the test block's argv is rewritten, by a marker comment the installer replaces. Add --no-detect to install.py as the override.
